integrity: The Apéry formula is credited to Liu and Xin; same-model review only. Finite computation independently cross-checks the result but is not a proof of the asymptotic theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: First-order genus, conductor, and layer asymptotics only; no exact finite-parameter genus or second-order constant. Uses classical Landau-Ramanujan theorem. The full latest version of related arXiv:2605.25542 was inaccessible.
title: Asymptotic Apéry-layer distribution and genus–conductor ratio for shifted-square semigroups
